title: Foreclosure Charge Schedule for Retention Payoff Approvals
content:
Foreclosure charge schedule — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

| Days from the referral date to the approval date | Status referred to foreclosure | Any other status |
|---|---|---|
| 30 or more | USD 2525.00 | nothing |
| fewer than 30, or no referral date | USD 875.00 | nothing |

**Clause.** On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the foreclosure charge enters the retention balance figure. The foreclosure charge is USD 2525.00, the full foreclosure charges, when the maturity case's status is referred to foreclosure and its referral date is at least 30 calendar days before the approval date; it is USD 875.00, the initial foreclosure charges, when its status is referred to foreclosure and it was referred fewer days before, a case with no referral date counting as referred 0 days before; a case in any other status carries nothing (0.00). Status and referral date are read from the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product.

**Boundary cases.**

| Maturity case on the approval date | Foreclosure charge |
|---|---|
| Referred to foreclosure, referral date 30 or more days before | USD 2525.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure, referral date 29 days before | USD 875.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure on the approval date itself (0 days) | USD 875.00 |
| Referred to foreclosure, no referral date recorded | USD 875.00 |
| Due and payable, or in its extension period | nothing |
